title: DiffPose
paper_title: Intraoperative 2D/3D Image Registration via Differentiable X-ray Rendering
core_mech: 合成 DRR 训练的 pose initializer 与可微 X-ray renderer 驱动的 SE(3) 测试时优化闭环结合。
core_mech_en: Couples a patient-specific SE(3) pose initializer (trained self-supervised on synthetic DRRs) with test-time gradient optimization through a differentiable X-ray ray-casting renderer.
input_desc: 术前 CT 体 V、术中 2D X-ray y、投影标定参数
input_en: Preoperative 3D CT volume V, intraoperative 2D X-ray fluoroscopy image y, and C-arm intrinsic calibration
output_desc: CT 到 X-ray 的刚体 SE(3) 位姿 T_hat
output_en: Sub-millimeter 6-DoF rigid pose T̂ ∈ SE(3) aligning preoperative CT to intraoperative X-ray

adapter.name: DiffPose
adapter.mechanism: A pose initializer and test-time gradient refinement share a differentiable rigid volume projector.
limitations: Normalized parallel-beam renderer; no calibrated cone-beam DiffDRR, patient-specific published pretraining or geodesic pose loss.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
